Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We're excited to move forward with Redwood as our strategic LLM inference partner. To get our consulting team trained and ready to scope customer engagements, can you share your standard SI onboarding materials and a proposed enablement timeline?

High-level asks from our side:
- A one-page partner playbook for consultant enablement (roles, orgs, expected outcomes).
- A 2-hour train-the-trainer session for 6 solution architects.
- A draft SOW template we can iterate on for first pilot engagements.

We'd love to schedule a kickoff the week of April 13–17; mornings PT generally work best. I'm looping David (partnership lead) on logistics.

Thanks,
Erin

Erin / Camila — quick technical note from the solutions team:

We propose the following technical enablement outline for the kickoff and follow-ups:

Kickoff (90m)
- 00–15m: Partnership objectives + product positioning (Camila)
- 15–45m: Deployment modes overview (hosted/dedicated/private) + decision matrix (Jonas)
- 45–75m: Console quick tour (tracing, per-route dashboards, token cost views) + demo (Dylan)
- 75–90m: Next steps + action items (all)

Train-the-trainer (2h)
- 00–30m: Common customer archetypes & mapping to Redwood configuration
- 30–90m: Hands-on lab (prefix caching, batching configs, model routing policies)
- 90–120m: Runbook delivery & QA (disaster/retry flows, fallback to variant models)

Sandbox request: Camila — please request a temp test workspace with these constraints:
- Region: us-west-2
- No persisted customer data (sample dataset only)
- Duration: 14 days post-training

Attachments referenced: SI_Kickoff_Slides.pptx (draft)

Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
